summary: Checkout is 11:00 AM — please start the dishwasher and leave used towels in the laundry room.
steps: Take home or discard any food items you brought.
No need to strip the beds or do any other cleanup. Our cleaning service takes care of it all. (But they appreciate tidy guests!)
Close and lock all the doors and windows.
Notify us of your departure (text or platform message is fine).
